hero.description: Start with authentic user reviews and preserve a complete evidence chain from feedback and findings to product requirements and test validation.

page.title: New Analysis
page.description: Import authentic or supplied user reviews and run deterministic validation, normalization, cleaning, and deduplication before semantic analysis begins.
page.scopeDescription: The current workflow covers review processing, runtime semantic analysis, evidence validation, and traceable Requirements, release planning, PRD, and Test Case generation.

form.title: Analysis input
form.description: Choose one data source and optionally describe what this analysis should focus on.
form.uploadHint: UTF-8 and UTF-8 BOM are supported. Maximum 10 MiB and 10,000 records.
form.goalPlaceholder: For example: Focus on subscription conversion, low ratings, and recent-version usability.
form.outputLanguageHint: Controls generated Topics and Finding Candidates only. Source reviews are never translated.

stages.EVIDENCE_VALIDATION: Validating Review IDs and run scope

semantic.title: AI Semantic Analysis
semantic.description: Use the configured runtime LLM to discover dataset-specific topics and extract unvalidated user-problem candidates with source Review IDs.
semantic.resumeHint: Completed review analysis and Finding Candidates are preserved. Retry resumes from the latest consolidation checkpoint instead of analyzing every review again.

errorCodes.LLM_OUTPUT_TRUNCATED: The model reached the configured output limit before completing the JSON response. Completed stages remain preserved.
errorCodes.LLM_EMPTY_CONTENT: The model returned empty content. No fallback result was fabricated.
errorCodes.LLM_INVALID_JSON: The model returned incomplete or malformed JSON.
errorCodes.LLM_SCHEMA_VALIDATION_FAILED: The model JSON did not match the semantic analysis contract.
errorCodes.LLM_CONTENT_FILTERED: The model provider filtered this structured response.
errorCodes.LLM_INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCE: Provider capacity was unavailable. Retry from the checkpoint later.
errorCodes.LLM_AUTHENTICATION_FAILED: The model provider rejected the configured API credentials. Check LLM_API_KEY and retry.
errorCodes.LLM_TIMEOUT: The model request timed out. Retry from the checkpoint later.
errorCodes.LLM_PROVIDER_ERROR: The model request failed. Check provider status, quota, and network access.
errorCodes.LINEAGE_LOSS: The consolidated result did not preserve the complete Review lineage and was rejected.
errorCodes.INVALID_REVIEW_ID: The model returned a Review ID outside the current Analysis Run and the result was rejected.
errorCodes.CROSS_RUN_REFERENCE: A cross-run reference was detected and the evidence chain was rejected.
errorCodes.INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE_OUTPUT: The model did not return a judgment for every Review in the current batch.
errorCodes.INVALID_STRUCTURED_OUTPUT: The model repeatedly returned output that did not match the evidence contract.

errors.start: Semantic analysis could not be started.
errors.poll: Semantic analysis status could not be refreshed.

evidence.title: Evidence Validation and Final Findings
evidence.description: The runtime model judges each Review against the candidate claim. Deterministic rules then calculate support, conflict, sufficiency, confidence, and evidence strength.
evidence.noEvidence: No valid evidence of this type was found.

errors.start: Evidence validation could not be started.

planning.title: Product Planning Workspace
planning.description: Generate Requirements, a Version Plan, a structured PRD, and Test Cases only from validated Findings while deterministic checks preserve evidence inheritance.
planning.noEligibleFindings: No sufficiently supported Finding is eligible for formal product planning. The system will not force Requirements from weak, conflicted, or unsupported evidence.
planning.failureSafety: Validated Findings remain preserved. The system never substitutes fabricated Requirements, PRDs, or Test Cases for a failed result.

errors.start: Product planning could not be started.
